notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. W4-SA52 2700 x 1200 (2015, 1:20), R150, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20), white. Four lines 140 D, baselines 280 / 540 / 800 / 1060 (sheet chain 280 / 260 / [20 + 20 underline] / 220 / 260 / 140: the underline of BOTH sits 20 below the second baseline and is 20 thick, the third baseline 220 below it): NO OVERTAKING 1426 overall from 205; UNLESS + BOTH 1236 overall from 295, BOTH in red '140 D @ 10 % oblique', underlined (480 wide underline: 1062/480/1158) — the red word and its underline are traced from the sheet's filled artwork (signgen has no oblique lettering); ONCOMING LANES 1595 overall from 120; ARE CLEAR 1018 from 408. Each word is placed where the sheet draws it (measured at 1200 dpi; widths agree with Series D). Warning panel 'W4-10(A)' 810 across its diagonals, 75 right of the third line (x 1790-2600, 100 from the right edge), 195 from top and bottom: yellow diamond (573 side) with edge 9.5 and black border 19 (the 600 mm sign's 10 / 30 at 810/848.5), corners R48; its three arrows (one up, two down) traced from the sheet.
